_doc: mark: [V] verified by reading the licence or release note IN THIS SESSION; [S] assumed (prior knowledge or an agent report, source not opened); [?] unknown.
redistributable: true/false/null. null = unknown, which World4 treats as NO.

lag_years: years between the end of a data year and its publication. known_time(year) = 1 July of (year + lag_years). An assumption [S] unless stated; it stops a backtest from using what had not been published yet.
World4 vendors no third-party data: the Atlas files are installed from the Atlas repo (see atlas_manifest.json) and only their provenance is recorded here.

wpp.name: UN World Population Prospects 2024
wpp.note: Years 2024+ are a PROJECTION published 2024-07, not data: known_time of all of them is 2024-07-11. F1 also reads the age-sex files of the R package PPgp/wpp2024 (wpp_manifest.json); their 1950-2023 estimates are revised history (revision leak not measured).

owid_co2.name: OWID co2-data (Global Carbon Project 2024)
owid_co2.license: CC BY 4.0 (OWID's; the underlying data keeps its own)

owid_energy.name: OWID energy-data (Energy Institute Statistical Review; EIA)
owid_energy.license: CC BY 4.0 (OWID's); Energy Institute licence not verifiable
owid_energy.note: F3 pins OWID energy-data at commit f8de88a (energy_manifest.json): primary energy by source, Energy Institute breakdown for 79 countries, the rest imputed from electricity generation. Not vendored.

emdat.name: EM-DAT (CRED/UCLouvain), public extract
emdat.note: EM-DAT terms do not allow redistributing the data. Neither World4 nor the Atlas should publish it; see the F0 report.

gfn.name: Global Footprint Network NFA 2018 / 2025
gfn.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Public Data Package, per research report 02)
gfn.note: Share-alike: validation target only, in a separate directory.

bhm_udel.name: Burke, Hsiang and Miguel (2015) replication data; U. Delaware v3.01

faostat_temp.name: FAOSTAT Temperature change on land (NASA GISTEMP)

gapminder.name: Gapminder fasttrack / open-numbers (UNEP-IRP; Hickel 2020; Harvard Growth Lab; WDI)
gapminder.license: CC BY 4.0 (Gapminder's); the underlying data keeps its own

owid_fiscal.name: ICTD/UNU-WIDER GRD, IMF Public Finances in Modern History, OECD SOCX + Lindert, Tanzi and Schuknecht (via OWID)
owid_fiscal.license: CC BY 4.0 (OWID's); the underlying data keeps its own

sipri.name: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database via OWID

macro_fin.name: Global Macro Database, IMF HPDD, Laeven-Valencia, Jorda-Schularick-Taylor

geopol.name: Powell and Thyne (coups), V-Dem RoW, Archigos, ATOP, WDI ODA

resources.name: OWID energy, reserves, giant fields, World Bank rents, nationalisations (Atlas curated table)

fair_calibration.name: FaIR calibration data 1.6.0 (calibrated, constrained ensemble; CMIP7 historical emissions and forcings)
fair_calibration.note: Licence read from the Zenodo record metadata in the F4 session (all versions of concept 7112539 are CC BY 4.0; resolves H17). The posterior was constrained with observed GMST up to 2023: climate parameters are in sample for any hindcast. Not vendored (climate_manifest.json).

hadcrut5.name: HadCRUT5 5.1.0.0 global annual mean surface temperature (Met Office Hadley Centre / CRU)
hadcrut5.note: Truth for GMST in W3/W4. Not vendored (climate_manifest.json).

fair_package.name: FaIR simple climate model, Python package 2.2.4
fair_package.note: Licence read from the installed package metadata in the F4 session. Software dependency (extra 'climate'); world4/sectors/_fair_step.py is derived from fair/fair.py (see NOTICE).

faostat_f5.name: FAOSTAT bulk files: QCL, RL, RFN, ESB, GT, FBSH, FBS
faostat_f5.license: CC BY 4.0 complemented by the FAO Statistical Database Terms of Use (no use in promoting a commercial enterprise)
faostat_f5.vintage: bulk files downloaded 2026-10-12 (FAO update dates in food_manifest.json)
faostat_f5.note: Licence read on fao.org (Statistical Database Terms of Use) in the F5 session. FAOSTAT revises its history and replaces the bulk files without versions: the manifest pins SHA-256 and a different file is a different vintage. Not vendored.

wdi_water.name: World Bank WDI ER.H2O.FWTL.K3 and ER.H2O.FWAG.ZS (from FAO AQUASTAT)
wdi_water.note: Agricultural freshwater withdrawals; sparse (AQUASTAT reports every ~5 years). Not vendored.

ucdp_ged.name: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset (GED) 26.1
ucdp_ged.note: Licence read on ucdp.uu.se/downloads in the F11 session. Installed with --install-conflict-grid and checked against conflict_grid_manifest.json (SHA-256 of ged261-csv.zip). Not vendored.

ucdp_candidate.name: UCDP Candidate Events Dataset 26.01.26.09
ucdp_candidate.note: Monthly release with at most one month of lag (UCDP). Preliminary: about a third of the 2026 events carry a 'Check ...' code_status. Used for the months after GED 26.1 and as the 2026 truth of the F11 validation.

priogrid.name: PRIO-GRID 2.0 (Tollefsen, Strand & Buhaug 2012)
priogrid.vintage: 2.0 (codebook 2016-06-02) through grid.prio.org/api; variables at their last year (2010-2014)
priogrid.note: Freely available with citation (codebook); no licence text found, so World4 treats it as not redistributable. The API JSON has no guaranteed order: conflict_grid_manifest.json pins the SHA-256 of each sorted (gid, value) table.

vensim_world3_03.name: Output of the Vensim World3-03 model (scenario 1), 5 variables, 1900-2100

pydynamo_world3_03.name: World3-03 equations in DYNAMO syntax (pydynamo)
pydynamo_world3_03.note: Source of the L0 transcription. Its SIMULATION departs from Vensim by up to 12 % (DYNAMO .j timing and a >= switch in 1940), so it is NOT a numerical reference.

pyworld3.name: pyworld3
pyworld3.note: 1974 version with different parameters and structure per its README. Neither used nor copied.
